classification: Post-event retrospective development study; all historical periods potentially opened
hypothesis: Partial pooling of same-horizon log changes, observed-offer replay, or matured-error calibration can lower seven-day quantile pinball relative to unchanged official drift; null and negative results retained
eligibility: Declared series with positive observations at origin and target; determined from target availability before candidate scores. One common cell set across all arms, methods failing use registered fallback and stay counted. Missing pairs reported separately.

pooling.state: last observed step direction and above/below last 30 observations median
pooling.donor_weighting: equal weight per donor series, not dollar levels

replay.membership_changes: Require explicit complete-collection attestation at both endpoints; otherwise reject transition. No such attestation inferred from row counts.
replay.internal_historical_state: Last observed prices may anchor known entrants only under attested complete collection; never emitted as observed quotes
replay.target_gate: Past-only daily reconstruction by last same-identity quote must match official target; ambiguous identity or mismatch gates replay to official drift

calibration.method: Per-horizon and per-base-forecaster additive signed forecast-error empirical quantile correction for each q; positivity floor 1e-8 and sort with correction receipt
calibration.label_maturity: Past forecast origin strictly earlier and target_date <= current origin
calibration.insufficient_history: Return uncalibrated base quantiles and count fallback

uncertainty.method: Descriptive paired moving-block bootstrap on origin-level mean loss differences

promotion: No retrospective promotion or replacement of official CSV. Prospective promotion only at fixed end analysis with compatible matured outcomes; otherwise pending

resources.cost: Unknown until provider receipt; do not estimate from credits

prospective.source: Licensed Hubbard source; independently defined aggregate new IDs
prospective.issuance_window: Following Monday 00:00–00:30 UTC; origin-day close unavailable until then
prospective.cohort_gate: Fresh, identity-compatible observed aggregates; no stale archive relabeling; replay additionally requires offer/target gate
prospective.pending_until: Compatible outcomes collected after issuance and target UTC day ends

news_measurement.interpretation: Retrieved sample counts, never total news frequency
news_measurement.primary_collection: NVIDIA RSS finite-document coverage; capture errors and missing pagination explicitly
news_measurement.signal_value_test: Not part of six-arm price-only study
